title: Connect remaining smoke interactions to production fixed ticks
requires: Production runtime/toolchain plus applicable physical GPU; cross-platform build evidence
scope: Bind remaining F8-19 smoke/rigid, smoke/cloth, smoke/soft-body and smoke/rope mechanical operators to the native production graph. Liquid/smoke binding belongs to F8-46; unavailable P-series smoke/smoke modes remain outside scope. Follow docs/roadmap/F8-SINGLE-EXECUTION-PATH.md.
acceptance: Every currently implemented smoke contact/drag tuple executes through the installed public API and real GPU dispatch, using the common epoch and four fixed sweeps.
Independent endpoint-domain, reciprocal exchange where specified, energy and mixed-family quality assertions pass without changing tolerances or pretending one-way modes are reciprocal.
Graph edits, endpoint destruction, reset, overflow and failed-tick recovery preserve one coherent commit and no double integration.
Map actual executed kernels and counters to canonical obligations; no platform-local physics or hidden fallback path.

history.reason: Connected every implemented smoke/rigid and smoke/deformable tuple to four-sweep production ticks with atomic public graph coverage and physical Pixel 7 Vulkan qualification.
